meta.tagline: Precision combination therapy for AML, designed by your patient's data.

landing.hero_subtitle: Upload the patient's NGS mutations, karyotype, labs, and RNA-Seq — get a publication-ready clinical report with evidence-matched regimens, clonal-biology rationale, and AI-predicted drug synergy.
landing.feature_1_body: Curated AML regimen database matched to the patient's driver biomarkers, fitness, and disease phase — with published CR/CRi and median OS for each.
landing.feature_2_body: Per-gene RNA-Seq outlier analysis for 25 core AML drivers + 8 hint genes. Catches cryptic events that NGS panels miss (e.g., EVI1 overexpression → inv(3) FISH).
landing.feature_3_body: Multi-task model trained on ex-vivo drug-sensitivity data predicts the top synergistic drug combinations for this patient, ranked by expected AUC.
landing.output_subtitle: A complete MDT-ready package in 30–120 seconds.
landing.output_2: Per-gene expression outlier table with clinical hints
landing.output_4: Top-3 regimen recommendations with clinical rationale
landing.output_6: REST API + programmatic access for your pipelines
landing.disclaimer_body: This platform is a research tool. It is not an FDA-cleared medical device and does not replace physician judgment. All predictions must be reviewed by a qualified clinician within the patient's full clinical context. Do not upload identifiable patient data — use de-identified labels only.

signup.title: Create your researcher account
signup.subtitle: Start uploading patients in under a minute. Free forever for research use.
signup.agreement: By signing up you agree to use this platform for research only and to never upload identifiable patient data (PHI).

dashboard.title: Your patients
dashboard.empty_body: Click '+ New patient' to submit your first case.

new_patient.title: Submit a new patient
new_patient.subtitle: Fill in NGS + karyotype + labs, upload RNA-Seq. Use a de-identified patient label — no real name, MRN, or DOB.
new_patient.smart_paste_body: Paste any clinical text — Excel cells, lab report text, hospital dump. Your stored LLM key extracts the fields automatically. You review and edit before submitting.
new_patient.smart_paste_placeholder: Paste clinical text here — supports English and Chinese...
new_patient.smart_paste_no_phi: ⚠ Do NOT paste identifiable patient data (real name, MRN, DOB).
new_patient.smart_paste_success: Filled {n} fields. Review the blue-highlighted values below before submitting.
new_patient.smart_paste_file_drop: Drop a CSV / TSV / TXT here, or click to browse
new_patient.smart_paste_file_hint: Accepts clinical tables (Excel cells exported as CSV) or RNA-Seq counts. Max 2 MB for smart parse.
new_patient.smart_paste_focus_patient: Target patient (MRN / name / ID / row number)
new_patient.smart_paste_focus_patient_placeholder: e.g. MRN-12345, A-001, row 3, or 张三
new_patient.smart_paste_focus_patient_hint: Leave blank if the file contains only one patient. Required if the file has multiple patients.
new_patient.smart_paste_auto_rna_detected: ✅ RNA-Seq counts auto-detected ({n} genes, mean={mean}). Will be used as the RNA-Seq input below — no AI call consumed.
new_patient.mutations_hint: Fields: gene (required), variant_type, vaf, is_ITD, is_TKD, allelic_ratio, is_biallelic.
new_patient.rna_full_hint: 2-column CSV. Enables the 25+8 expression outlier table + full-transcriptome scan.

api_keys.title: API keys
api_keys.subtitle: Authenticate programmatic calls to /api/v1/*. Use as Authorization: Bearer ac_live_... header.
api_keys.new_warning: Copy this now — it will NEVER be shown again.

llm_keys.title: LLM keys (Bring Your Own Key)
llm_keys.subtitle: Add your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key to enable optional LLM features. Keys are AES-128 encrypted at rest. All usage is billed to your account.

patient_detail.status_queued_body: Prediction queued. This page auto-refreshes every 5 seconds until the report is ready.
patient_detail.status_running_body: Prediction running. This page auto-refreshes every 5 seconds until the report is ready.
patient_detail.llm_summary_body: Use your stored LLM API key to generate a short plain-English summary. Your key is never logged; calls go directly to OpenAI / Anthropic billed against your own account.

common.not_for_clinical: Not for clinical diagnosis or therapy selection
common.footer_disclaimer: Research use only. Not for clinical diagnosis. All predictions must be reviewed by a qualified clinician.
